cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The car won't start. Wonderful, a walking lesson! I taught you to navigate without that phone; now you can show me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's pouring. I was hoping to stay dry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better: you'll finally use my lesson about finding shelter. Lead us from awning to awning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The next awning's gone, and my shoe's filling with water.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Brilliant, you're reading conditions as well as the map. Take my arm; today you graduate to choosing a route for two people.

reason: Interpret B weather setbacks as increasingly advanced real navigation opportunities, with A offering support while claiming the pupil progress.
